messages.subject: [SetAttribute]->SetAttribute->[SetAttribute]
parts:
I have a little DES framework I've been using. After a recent update of simmer it's now crashing and I can't figure out why.

What does this mean?

Error: 'patient0' at 0.00 in [SetAttribute]->SetAttribute->[SetAttribute]:
 Not compatible with requested type: [type=NULL; target=double]

It's probably something I've done, but I can't figure out this error message or where it's coming from.

messages.author: 57a7662e790ccc92
messages.subject: Re: [SetAttribute]->SetAttribute->[SetAttribute]
parts:
Nevermind, I found the verbose=TRUE option and boom right on the problem.

I had a variable in my inputs hash that was NULL. setting an attribute to NULL causes this issue.

Yeap, some errors may not be very helpful. Let me walk you through it:

This comes from simmer. I tried to put some context when an error
happens, so this means that a set_attribute is failing that is in
between... another two set_attribute activities. So in this case, the
context is not so helpful. Maybe I can try to improve these errors in
the future with some kind of stack trace or something.
>> Not compatible with requested type: [type=NULL; target=double]

And this comes from Rcpp. It tells you that a NULL was received
(type), but a double was expected (target).
